content.title: Mercedes-Benz acquires stake in Chinese autonomous driving developer for US$191 million
content.summary: Mercedes-Benz on Thursday said it completed the acquisition of a 3 per cent stake, worth 1.34 billion yuan (US$191 million), in motorcycle maker-turned-autonomous driving systems developer Chongqing Qianli Technology, three months after the deal was first announced. The transaction involved Mercedes-Benz Digital Technology, the German carmaker's tech unit, and Shanghai-listed Lifan Holdings, which transferred 135.6 million shares of Qianli at 9.87 yuan per share. content.title: How the Narrative Surrounding Mercedes-Benz Has Shifted Amid Upgraded Targets and Persistent Risks
content.summary: Mercedes-Benz Group’s fair value estimate has nudged higher to about €62.76 per share, while the discount rate and revenue growth outlook remain essentially unchanged, signaling a cautiously more constructive view on intrinsic worth rather than a wholesale shift in fundamentals. The modest uplift reflects a market narrative that is being recalibrated in response to stronger perceived balance sheet resilience and premium brand durability, even as macro risks and competitive pressures persist...
